R C6 radiculopathy and R elbow pain are clearly associated in the data. Elbow pain occurs in 4.4% of patients with R C6 radiculopathy (181 of 4,076) and in 2.4% of those without it (301 of 12,308). So option C, no relationship, is unlikely.

The table can't show the direction. I chose A on clinical grounds: a compressed or irritated C6 nerve root (a pathophysiological diagnosis) produces pain in its dermatome (a symptom), not the other way round.

ANSWER: A
